## Data {#data-origin}

Collared flycatcher nest-box monitoring, Gotland, Sweden.

| Dataset | Records | Coverage |
|---|---:|---|
| [CF source dataset](data_raw/birds/CF21980-2025.csv) · [GitHub](https://github.com/anetaarct/thermal-conditions-reproduction-cf-publication/blob/main/data_raw/birds/CF21980-2025.csv) | 15,984 | 1980–2025 |
| [Clutch model input](data_derived/analysis/clutch_model_data.csv) | 12,627 | 1981–2025, excluding 2020 |
| [Fledging model input](data_derived/analysis/fledging_model_data.csv) | 9,790 | 1981–2019 |
| [Annual laying dates](data_derived/annual_raw_median_laying_date.csv) | 45 seasons | Sliding-window response |
| [Daily temperature](data_derived/smhi_hoburg_daily_temperature.csv) | 46 seasons | 1980–2025 |
| [Annual temperature](data_derived/annual_main_window_temperature.csv) | 46 seasons | 26 March–7 May |

[Source provenance and checksum](data_raw/birds/README.md) · [Variables and centring](data_derived/analysis/README.md) · [SMHI observations](https://www.smhi.se/data/sok-oppna-data-i-utforskaren/se-acmf-meteorologiska-observationer-lufttemperatur-medelvarde-1-dygn)

The source CSV is semicolon-delimited. Final model inputs contain the selected records and prepared predictors; NDVI and mismatch were not model predictors.

## Refit {#refit-from-the-public-model-data}

[Repository ZIP](https://github.com/anetaarct/thermal-conditions-reproduction-cf-publication/archive/refs/heads/main.zip) · [Runner](R/94_reproduce_from_public_data.R) · [Validator](R/95_validate_public_model_data.R)

Run from the repository root in local R:

```r
install.packages(c("glmmTMB", "MASS"))
```

```bash
Rscript R/95_validate_public_model_data.R
Rscript R/94_reproduce_from_public_data.R
```

Outputs: `models/`, `tables/reproduced/`, `tables/within_between_20261026_reproduced/`, `figures/reproduced/`.

Browser R controls perform the indicated checks and calculations; mixed-model refits require local R. The window search uses annual laying-date summaries and 500 independent randomisations.

## Software {#software-used-for-the-reported-fits}

Reported fits: R 4.6.1; glmmTMB 1.1.14 (baseline), 1.1.15.2 (within–between refits). Reproduction runner: glmmTMB ≥1.1.14. Figure scripts: Python, pandas, matplotlib.
